messages:
Anil: Quick heads-up — I'm drafting a lightweight PII-bucketing + sampling flow for request/response logs. Goal: let Console show sampled traces without storing raw PII, enforce per-tenant quota, and keep rollout cheap. Looking for quick :eyes: from infra + telemetry.
Maya: link pls? where are you sketching this? :eyes:
Anil: Draft is on the working doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/pii-sampleflow (proto). Basic idea: deterministic sampling at the edge, tag a risk bucket, redact at ingress, then route sampled blobs to ephemeral storage for inspect. Keep default sample very low (0.5%-1%).
Kevin: two immediate asks: 1) route-level overrides (some routes should be higher by default), 2) quota accounting must be token-based not event-based. We can't let a single tenant burn burst credits via large embeddings.
Sara: Important: redaction must happen before any central batching/KV-cache keys are computed. Also embeddings are tricky — hashes + feature extraction might still leak. We should treat embedding payloads as high-risk unless client-side pseudonymized.
Jess: Console UX idea: show sampling % per-route in the Routes table, with a small disclosure to expand and see PII-bucket distribution (low/med/high) and a one-click "request inspect" flow that issues ephemeral tokens.
ops-bot: PR created: github.com/redwood/pii-sampleflow/pull/3452 — includes YAML config + simple simulator :hammer_and_wrench:
Anil: rough config sketch:
```
sampling:
  default_rate: 0.01
  route_overrides:
    "/chat/completions": 0.025
    "/embeddings": 0.002
  deterministic_key: "tenant_hmac_v1"
  pii_bucket_thresholds:
    high: 0.85
    medium: 0.4
    low: 0.1
  redact_stage: ingress
  ephemeral_ttl_seconds: 900
```
Maya: For metrics: we need counters:
- sampled_events_total{route,tenant,bucket}
- sampled_pii_events_total{route,tenant,bucket}
- redact_failures_total
And a dashboard that shows sampled volume vs quota burn rate.
Kevin: agree. Also add a gauge for "effective_sample_rate" observed (helpful for rollout validation). For deterministic sampling use HMAC(tenant_id + route) with a rotationable key.
Sara: On storage: ephemeral blobs must be WORM for TTL then fully deleted; audit-bot must capture who requested inspect tokens. Also, do not allow raw embeddings to persist — offer hashed feature-only view for inspect sessions.
Jess: UX: make the inspect token creation require an approval flow for high PII buckets (audit trail + manager ack). For low buckets can be auto-approved but logged.
Anil: Action items I can take: 1) land a small simulator + test vectors, 2) wire up sampling config to routing layer, 3) draft console mock for the route list + inspect flow. Who can own metrics/dash?
Maya: I'll take metrics + grafana dashboard. Will add alert: sampled_pii_events_total > 10/min for any tenant -> paging-policy.
Kevin: I'll own the deterministic HMAC implementation and quota math. Will prototype token-bucket enforcement at the edge.
Sara: I'll write redaction checklist and embedding-specific guidance. Also add a small CLI tool to verify no PII in cached keys.
Jess: I'll mock the Console screens and the inspect modal (include TTL and approver list). Will include a small permission matrix.
audit-bot: New audit rule queued: "inspect_token_approval" requires at least one approver for bucket=high. Rule id: AR-1087.
Anil: Great — let's sync briefly tomorrow 10:30am PT. If folks can review PR #3452 before then that would speed things up. Thanks :pray:
Maya: Reviewing today.
Kevin: Will add unit tests by EOD.
Sara: acked. :white_check_mark:
Jess: :rocket:
